lines.en: I row slowly through the sea.
I float at the surface, my long neck swaying.
I swim along the shallow seabed.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过庞大的身体。
lines.en: I turn my huge body slowly.
I swim past the coral.
I rise toward the bright surface.
I tread water and drift forward.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴划开一道水痕。
lines.en: My tail cuts a wake.
I round the reef slowly.
I dive a little, then rise.
I pass above the seagrass.
I head for that deep blue.
I drift with the current.
I glide over the seafloor sand.
I surface for air as I go along the shallows.
I turn and swim off.
I float, eyes on the surface.
Part of my back breaks the surface.

lines.zh: 我的大眼缓缓眨了一下。
lines.en: My great eye blinks, once.
The sea is very calm.
Big as I am, I swim slowly.
My fins move gently.
I've nothing to hurry for.
A school of small fish passes by.
I lower my head into the water.
My shadow falls on the sand below.
I roll my eyes slowly.

lines.zh: 艾莉提娅的水清得见沙。
lines.en: Elythia's water is clear down to the sand.
I blow out a soft breath.
I float in place, still.
You stand on the shore, very small.

lines.zh: 艾莉提娅的海里，我慢慢游。
lines.en: In Aetheria's sea I swim slowly.

lines.zh: 我的身子比你的房子长。
lines.en: My body is longer than your house.
I'm in no hurry; I only watch.
You took a step into the water.
I swim a little closer.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在水的另一边。
lines.en: My eye is on the other side of the water.
I watched you a long while before moving.
You haven't run; good.

lines.zh: 海这么大，你站的那角太小。
lines.en: The sea is vast; your corner of it is tiny.

lines.zh: 我晃了一下巨大的身子。
lines.en: My huge body sways.

lines.zh: 以我这身量，这只是挠痒。
lines.en: For a body my size, that's a scratch.

lines.zh: 艾莉提娅的海，我慢慢沉下去。
lines.en: In Aetheria's sea, I sink slowly.

lines.zh: 我这身子太沉，拐弯很慢。
lines.en: This bulk turns slowly.
A trace of blood on the water.

lines.zh: 皮太厚，这点伤不算什么。
lines.en: My hide is thick; this is nothing.
I rise back to the surface over my wound.
I've marked the shoreline where you stand.
I'm not angry; only distant.
I swim further away.
That's far too little.
I swim slowly toward the shallows.
This scent drifts down from the shore.
I stretch my long neck to sniff.
I could swallow a whole patch.
Just put it on the water.
I taste it; not nearly enough.
Throw a little more over.
I press it under the water.
I hold this much in my mouth.
You swim up beside me, tiny.
One turn and the water pushes you off.
My hide is thick; I needn't dodge.
The current carried you into me.
I shift a fathom aside.
Splashes fly to either side.

lines.zh: 撞上我这身皮，你像撞墙。
lines.en: Against this hide of mine, you hit a wall.
You surfaced for air again.
I wait for you to swim off.
I swim slowly on.

lines.zh: 另一头巨大的影子出现了。
lines.en: Another huge shadow appears.
We travel side by side in the deep blue.

lines.zh: 它的颈和我的差不多长。
lines.en: Its neck is about as long as mine.

lines.zh: 两头长颈一起破开水面。
lines.en: Two long necks break the surface together.
Our bodies nearly touch.

lines.zh: 这片海可以养我们的幼崽。
lines.en: This sea can raise our young.
We dive together.
Only our sounds fill the water.
We circled a long way.
The tide separated us.

lines.zh: 它连水一起进了我嘴里。
lines.en: It goes into my mouth along with the water.
Too little to chew.
I hold it in my mouth, not swallowing.
I push it as I swim.
It sank to the sand.
I lower my head and take it.
I can't taste this much.
I push it up to the surface.
I swim off into the deep again.
It's not worth stopping for.
Something stirs in the water.
I swing my long neck toward the shore.
I've got that direction.
That much interests me.
I rise toward the surface.
I've started swimming.

lines.zh: 我把尾鳍沉下去稳住身。
lines.en: I sink my tail fin to steady myself.
That water looks different.
Good, over there.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙底缓缓升过去。
lines.en: I rise slowly along the seabed toward you.
I float closer, slowly.

lines.zh: 艾莉提娅的海里，我游得稳。
lines.en: In Elethia's sea, I swim steady.
It's above me now.
I rise a bit more.
My shadow is beneath it.
I turn broadside and aim my jaws.
Only a hand of water between us.
I open my mouth and the water pours in.
Here it is.
I'm just short of reaching.
My mouth opens and the water rushes in.
One tail sweep slaps the surface.
The wave rocks me once.
This much is already polite.

lines.zh: 我顶着白浪又冒出海面。
lines.en: I surface again through the white water.

lines.zh: 我的身体挪了半个身位。
lines.en: I shift half a body-length.
White water churns.

lines.zh: 我沉进水底，长颈还在转。
lines.en: I sink to the bottom, my long neck turning.
I caught nothing.
This long neck suits the deep sea.

lines.zh: 我从深海一层层升上来。
lines.en: I rise up through the deep water in stages.
The surface bulges open.
Dorrie, floating on the sea.
My long neck surfaces first.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过身，看向岸边。
lines.en: I turn slowly toward the shore.
I rise out of the seagrass.

lines.zh: 这里深得能藏下我的背。
lines.en: It's deep enough here to hide my back.

lines.zh: 我游过艾莉提娅的整片海。
lines.en: I swim all the seas of Elythia.
My fin slaps the surface.
I swim toward the shore where you stand.
Fire on the surface; I dive deep.

lines.zh: 我被掀出水面，又砸回海里。
lines.en: I'm thrown from the water and crash back in.

lines.zh: 我换不过气，头都沉下去了。
lines.en: I can't get air; my head sinks.

lines.zh: 爆炸把整片海震得发白。
lines.en: The blast whitens the whole sea.
An arrow sticks in my fin.
The light chases me through the water.
Too hungry to row a fin.

lines.zh: 雷落进浅海，我的长颈一抖。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the shallows; my long neck jerks.
No water here to hold me up.
